road.title: Plans and musts
road.place: The Sensible Green at the Usual Place
road.description: A small, square figure in an apron stiff with official starch, sitting on a trunk they will not discuss. Eudora is a Keeper of Good Intentions and stores them over the winter, labelled, and notes that very few are ever collected.

openObjectives.prompt: Eudora has your weekend open on the desk and it is, so far, blank. Tell Eudora what you want to do this weekend, using Italian.
Tell Eudora something that you have to do this week, using Italian.
Eudora deals in the near future and would like yours in advance. Tell Eudora what you are going to do tomorrow, using Italian.

character.name: Eudora Inkpen
character.description: A small, square figure in an apron stiff with official starch, sitting on a trunk they will not discuss. Eudora is a Keeper of Good Intentions and stores them over the winter, labelled, and notes that very few are ever collected.

npc.narrative: You reach the piazza on a clear mattina, where Eudora Inkpen sits sotto il sole at a tavolo of small vasi, each with an etichetta and none with a padrone. A cartello by her gomito gives her orario, which is blank in a way that suggests fiducia. She looks up as if you were something she had put in a cassetto.
npc.native: Buongiorno! Questo fine settimana voglio riposare, domani penso di contare le etichette e questa settimana devo trovare la penna. E tu, cosa fai questo fine settimana, domani e durante la settimana? E come va la tua mattina?
npc.translation: Good morning! This weekend I want to rest, tomorrow I plan to count the labels and this week I have to find the pen. And you, what are you doing this weekend, tomorrow and during the week? And how is your morning going?

player: Buongiorno! La mia mattina va bene, c'è il sole. Questo fine settimana voglio andare al mare con mia sorella.

verdict.overallFeedback: Lovely answer! You told Eudora that your morning is going well and that you want to go to the sea with your sister, all in correct Italian.

objectiveResults.feedback: Well done, you said what you want to do this weekend with "voglio andare al mare".

vocabularyEvidence.evidence: Questo fine settimana voglio andare al mare con mia sorella.

objectiveResults.feedback: Eudora also wants to hear something you have to do this week. We'll ask you for this again soon.
Eudora also wants to know what you are planning to do tomorrow. We'll ask you for this again later.

openObjectives.prompt: Tell Eudora something that you have to do this week, using Italian.
Eudora deals in the near future and would like yours in advance. Tell Eudora what you are going to do tomorrow, using Italian.

npc.narrative: Eudora sets down her penna, a gesto she will regret in about a minuto. Il sole comes through the finestra onto a shelf of etichette, nearly tutte still waiting for someone. She nods at the word mare like a woman who has been told about a cousin.
npc.native: Che bello, il mare! Io devo trovare la penna questa settimana, e domani penso di contare le etichette. Come si chiama tua sorella? E tu, cosa devi fare questa settimana, e cosa pensi di fare domani?
npc.translation: How lovely, the sea! I have to find the pen this week, and tomorrow I plan to count the labels. What is your sister called? And you, what do you have to do this week, and what are you thinking of doing tomorrow?

player: Mia sorella si chiama Giulia. Questa settimana devo lavorare molto, e devo andare dal dentista. Uffa!

verdict.overallFeedback: Lovely answer! You told Eudora your sister's name and two things you have to do this week, all in correct Italian. Next, tell her about tomorrow.

objectiveResults.feedback: Well done: you said what you have to do this week, using "devo" correctly.
You didn't say what you are thinking of doing tomorrow. Eudora will ask again, so tell her your plan for tomorrow.

openObjectives.prompt: Eudora deals in the near future and would like yours in advance. Tell Eudora what you are going to do tomorrow, using Italian.

npc.narrative: Eudora nods con gentilezza, as if the dentista were an ufficio with worse orari. Behind her, a scaffale of vasi waits for the inverno, each with an etichetta, and nobody has come for any of them, nemmeno oggi.
npc.native: Giulia, che bel nome! Poverino, il dentista, e tanto lavoro... uffa davvero. Io domani penso di contare le etichette, e penso di cercare la penna dopo. E tu, cosa pensi di fare domani? E cosa ne pensi del mio lavoro con le etichette?
npc.translation: Giulia, what a lovely name! Poor you, the dentist, and so much work... a real ugh indeed. Tomorrow I am thinking of counting the labels, and I am thinking of looking for the pen afterwards. And you, what are you thinking of doing tomorrow? And what do you think of my work with the labels?

player: Domani vado a fare la spesa e poi cucino per Giulia. Il tuo lavoro è... interessante, credo.

verdict.overallFeedback: Lovely answer! You said what you'll do tomorrow, mentioned Giulia, and gave your opinion about Eudora's work, all in clear Italian.

objectiveResults.feedback: You told Eudora your plans for tomorrow in good Italian, but without the phrase for "I'm thinking of"; try "Domani penso di fare la spesa".

npc.narrative: Eudora sits at her tavolo, surrounded by etichette and a great deal of carta. She lifts a piccolo cartellino, frowns at it, and puts it down in un altro posto. Il sole comes through the finestra and falls on the whole quiet disorder.
npc.native: Che bello, la spesa e la cena per Giulia! Interessante, credo: è la risposta più onesta! Domani io penso di contare le etichette e penso di cercare la penna. E tu, cosa pensi di cucinare per Giulia, e cosa pensi di fare dopo cena?
npc.translation: How lovely, the shopping and dinner for Giulia! Interesting, I think: it is the most honest answer! Tomorrow I am thinking of counting the labels and I am thinking of looking for the pen. And you, what are you thinking of cooking for Giulia, and what are you thinking of doing after dinner?

player: Penso di cucinare la pasta con il pesce. Dopo cena guardiamo un film. E tu, hai trovato la penna?

npc.narrative: Eudora lifts the lid of a small scatola, looks in, and puts it back with the air of someone who has checked. Through the finestra the sun lights forty-one etichette, ogni one labelled for an inverno not yet arrived. Sul tavolo there is everything except a pen.
npc.native: Pasta con il pesce, che buono! No, non ho ancora trovato la penna: forse è nella scatola, o forse è sul tavolo. Che film guardate tu e Giulia dopo cena? E cosa vuoi sapere del mio lavoro?
npc.translation: Pasta with fish, how lovely! No, I have not found the pen yet: maybe it is in the box, or maybe it is on the table. What film do you and Giulia watch after dinner? And what do you want to know about my work?

player: Non lo so, forse un film comico. Perché tieni le buone intenzioni? Nessuno viene a prenderle!

npc.narrative: Eudora looks at the scatola, then at the tavolo, with the air of someone who has put the answer down somewhere. Outside, the sole is high and the strada is, for now, in the same place as ieri. A label on the lid says "forse", in handwriting that has been waiting a while.
npc.native: Un film comico, che bella idea! Tengo le buone intenzioni perché un giorno qualcuno può venire. Le metto in una scatola con l'etichetta, e d'inverno le conservo con cura. Ma dimmi, tu quale buona intenzione hai per questa settimana, e cosa vuoi sapere ancora del mio lavoro?
npc.translation: A comedy, what a nice idea! I keep the good intentions because one day somebody may come. I put them in a box with a label, and in winter I look after them carefully. But tell me, which good intention do you have for this week, and what else do you want to know about my work?

player: La mia buona intenzione: andare in palestra. Ma non vado mai! Puoi tenerla tu?

npc.narrative: Eudora holds out both mani, as if the intenzione were a small, warm gatto. Behind her, a scatola on the tavolo is labelled with a date that has already passato. She writes your nome on an etichetta, lentamente, and the sole through the finestra makes it look ufficiale.
npc.native: Sì, la tengo io, volentieri! La metto nella scatola con il tuo nome e un'etichetta. Poche persone tornano a prenderle, ma io le conservo con cura. Perché non vai mai in palestra, e cosa vuoi sapere ancora del mio lavoro?
npc.translation: Yes, I'll keep it myself, gladly! I put it in the box with your name and a label. Few people come back to collect them, but I store them with care. Why do you never go to the gym, and what else do you want to know about my work?
